 The usual routes
 Workshops and retainers, when you wanted a website 
 1 What gets sold to you
 Agencies quote for discovery workshops and retainers when you need a clear site that brings in enquiries. Or you built it yourself on a site builder and it never shows up when people search.
 2 Paying twice
 Reading has plenty of competition, and every unclear page or slow load on a phone is a reason for a buyer to click back. Paying an agency rate for a site that still does not bring work in costs twice.
 3 One person doing the work
 A site built by the person you speak to, with your services and areas laid out, set up for Google, and a fixed price agreed before work starts.

 Fair questions
 Asked by Reading firms weighing up an agency 
 Why a web designer and not an agency?
 One person, one price and no hand-offs. The honest catch is that one person has limits: there are no in-house copywriters, only Andy working from what you tell him, and he can only run so many builds at once. If you need a large team, an agency is the better call.
 Do you cover Wokingham, Earley and Woodley?
 Yes, plus Caversham, Tilehurst, Theale and Twyford.
 What does SEO cost in Reading?
 Local SEO support is £497 a month, covering map-rank reports, review requests and Google profile upkeep. The full scope, and what is left out, is on the Reading SEO page .
 What will the website itself cost?
 Starter is £600 for five pages and Core is £995 for eight. Further pages are £125, and hosting and care comes to £10 a month. Those figures are the same before and after your first conversation with Andy.
 How long will Andy need?
 With one person on the job and no queue of approvals, the usual span is 1 to 3 weeks from your deposit.
 Would I depend on Andy forever?
 No. You own the site once it is paid for. A one-person business should not be a single point of failure for your website, and owning it means you could take it elsewhere.

## https://readingwebsitedesign.co.uk/about-andy

The designer, by name
 Andy Norman, a designer rather than an agency 
 Andy's career began on the road as a field engineer. Over 30 years in field service and managed print took him up to service manager, and then he left to found Antek Automation.
 Managing teams taught him what happens to a customer's request as it passes from person to person. His answer for Reading clients is to have no one to pass it to.
 What a one-person studio can and cannot do
 You get continuity, quick decisions and the builder on the phone. You do not get a bench of specialists or a copywriting department, and Andy would rather say so before you sign.
 Desk at Chantry Way, Andover

 Work beyond the website
 Antek Automation also sets up AI receptionists and chatbots, for owners who want calls handled when they are busy. Website design from Antek is the place to see how those connect.

## https://readingwebsitedesign.co.uk/seo-reading

SEO · Reading
 SEO in Reading, with one named contact 
 Comparing an SEO agency in Reading with an SEO company down the road usually means comparing vague packages. This one is a fixed monthly scope at £497, and you deal with Andy Norman.
 SEO in Reading is competitive, so the work concentrates on what a local firm can control: its Google profile, its reviews and how it shows on the map in the areas it serves.
 What £497 a month pays for
 The list is short on purpose, and it does not change from one month to the next without you agreeing to it.
 A monthly LocalFalcon map-rank report across the areas you cover
 Review requests and replies through the CRM
 Scheduled Google profile posts
 Google profile upkeep
 A monthly summary
 What you will not be sold
 Andy does not promise rankings, and he does not offer link building, paid ads or suspension recovery. Tidying up citations is possible as an add-on, priced per job. If you also want a new site, Antek's website work is where that starts.
